Only globally inconsistent or non-nested rows are repaired; smaller contours in individual quadrants can be legitimate.
Keep feasible outer contours; repair impossible contours with decay inferred from the coherent source landfall R34/RMW ratio.
Continuous angular wind extent is interpolated between quadrant centres; no additional translation-speed boost is added.
